mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend consistently reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods where FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings deterioration and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate a contraction in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of broader demand weakness and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production contraction (INDPRO < 100), manufacturing sector weakness leads to reduced corporate profitability and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO < 100, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the year-over-year CPI inflation rate above 2.5% for three consecutive months signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising employment trend (PAYEMS) consistently indicates strong labor market conditions, supporting consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1,100,000 units for two consecutive months signals robust residential demand, which typically precedes economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicate strong housing demand, which is a leading indicator of overall economic expansion and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST increase, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
